<!--
To list a mod: add entries/<id>.json and nothing else (docs/listing.md).
The check posts what it found about your repo and newest release below;
a maintainer reviews it against this list.
-->

**Mod:** <!-- id and repo, for example gravel-rally from your-login/gravel-rally -->

**What it does:** <!-- one or two sentences -->

### Review (for the maintainer; items marked U also for each update)

- [ ] The pull request's author owns or administers the repo; the repo is public and genuine.
- [ ] Name, id, authors, summary and icon do not pose as Bururu, a game studio or another mod; no "official" in the name; the summary says what the mod does.
- [ ] (U) Every folder it reads sits inside the game's own folders and fits what the mod does; the screen and every UDP port are explained in the README; a forward off this PC only when the README names the program it feeds and why.
- [ ] (U) The Lua is read in full for a new mod, the diff for an update; no obfuscated or minified code; nothing reaches for globals the sandbox removes; it does what the README says.
- [ ] (U) Dependencies are listed mods; no surprise new dependency.
- [ ] README and CHANGELOG are plain and honest; no "get the full version elsewhere"; a licence file is there.
- [ ] (U) No drift: the same repo id and owner id.
- [ ] Taste notes of `mod check` looked at (not a gate).
